The '''Onyx Beacon''' was a base of operations in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].

==History==
Home to the [[Blacklight Pirates]], the Onyx Beacon served as an origin for "seedy" business. Little else was known about the Onyx Beacon as it was jealously guarded by its inhabitants.
